subject: ClearBridge evaluation: access runbook, success criteria & ownership
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Khan <jenna.khan@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearBridge evaluation: access runbook, success criteria & ownership

Hi Jenna —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap & next steps so we have a clear ops plan for the 4‑week evaluation you agreed to run:

1) Success criteria (your team):
- 95% intent recognition on the 3 pilot workflows (search assist, ticket summarization, recommender prompts)
- P99 latency < 450ms for 256 token responses in our Seattle region
- Monthly token spend projection within the committed cap (we'll model this)

2) Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access & baseline data ingest
- Week 1: initial runs, latency and quality checks
- Week 2: model tuning (prompt sets & reranking) and quantization trial if needed
- Week 3: load validation and failover testing
- Week 4: final report and handoff

3) Access we need from ClearBridge to start:
- One SSO invite for the Redwood console (SAML) for your Ops lead (jenna.khan@clearbridge.ai)
- Static IP ranges to allowlist for our staging endpoints (we'll provide the IPs)
- A short-lived API key for service-to-service calls (scoped to eval) or a proof-of-concept token we can exchange with your infra team

Can you confirm owners for SSO and IP allowlist? If you prefer, I can loop in Markus (security) and Monica (ops) to coordinate a 30‑minute kickoff.

Attached: access_matrix spreadsheet (initial pad for teams/roles + required artifacts).

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0191

Attachment: clearbridge_access_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Jenna Khan <jenna.khan@clearbridge.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@example.com>, Ops Team <ops@clearbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge evaluation: access runbook, success criteria & ownership

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

• Success criteria: the product team will add two business KPIs (reduced triage time and satisfaction delta) to your list; we'll share baseline numbers by Friday.
• SSO: I'll own adding the SAML connection, but the exec who needs access initially is Tom Baker (tbaker@example.com).
• IP allowlist: Ops will need the exact IPs to allow; we can approve a CIDR block for staging.
• API key: We prefer a scoped key with read-only and model-call permissions for the trial. Can Redwood generate?

Let's do the kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT with Markus and Monica included. I'll send a calendar invite.

—Jenna
Head of Product, ClearBridge Analytics
jenna.khan@clearbridge.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge evaluation: access runbook, success criteria & ownership

Looping in a quick security checklist so Monica and I can own the pieces:

- SAML config: we need metadata URL + SP ACS from ClearBridge. We'll provide our IdP metadata.
- IP allowlist: we'll publish 3 staging IPs and a /28 block for load tests.
- API key: Redwood can mint a scoped key for the eval; recommend 7‑day TTL and scope to the test project.
- Audit: enable request logging and 30‑day retention for the trial (we can extend if needed).

Monica — can you take the provisioning runbook and assign owners for console invites & project creation? I'll handle the API key TTL and audit config.

—Markus
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Khan <jenna.khan@clearbridge.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge evaluation: access runbook, success criteria & ownership

Hi Jenna — thanks for the pickup. I took notes during the kickoff and attached an updated access matrix with owners. Quick plan:

- Monica (me): console project creation, initial roles, generate temporary service account for tokens, invite Tom to the console (SAML mapping)
- Markus: security policy, IP publishing, audit retention settings
- Sean (CS): success criteria instrumentation and report template; he'll reach out for sample datasets and prompt files

Action items for ClearBridge:
1) Provide SAML metadata + list of users to map (Tom + 2 devs)
2) Approve CIDR block or confirm you only want our three staging IPs added
3) Confirm whether the token should be delivered via secure vault (preferred) or sent over email

I'll generate the scoped API key once SAML mapping and project are ready — that keeps the key short‑lived and tied to the eval project. Attaching the matrix and the Redwood POC template.

Best —
Monica
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

We can do the SAML metadata and mapping today. Attached are the baseline KPI exports for ticket volume and triage times (csv). Ops will approve the /28 for your load tests; please publish the IPs before Monday so we can schedule the firewall change.

- Monica has created the eval project: redwood-clb-eval-072 (console link: https://app.redwood.ai/projects/redwood-clb-eval-072)
- Markus published three staging IPs: 34.201.12.8, 34.201.12.9, 34.201.12.10 and a /28 for load tests (ops confirmed)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to week 1 results.

Rishi
